data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'khazaara', which means 'to fortify' or 'to protect'. Khuzarah is a name that symbolizes strength and devotion to God, evoking images of a fortified castle or stronghold. The name Khuzarah carries the meaning “Fortress of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuzarah usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
